app_description.message: Merge and shuffle YouTube / YouTube Music playlists, then play them back with YouTube's own player.

add_placeholder.message: Paste a YouTube or YouTube Music playlist URL

playlists_empty.message: No playlists yet. Paste a playlist URL above to start.

mode_consecutive_random_desc.message: Alternates between playlists, taking one random unused track per turn.

mode_full_shuffle_desc.message: Mixes the tracks of every playlist into a single pool.

mode_proportional_desc.message: Alternates while respecting the relative size of each playlist.

mode_sequential_blocks_desc.message: Plays playlist by playlist, each one shuffled internally.

mode_none_desc.message: Concatenates the playlists in their original order.

dedupe_desc.message: A track present in several playlists only enters the mix once.

reshuffle_rounds_desc.message: Changes the playlist order on every round for more variety.

queue_finished.message: The queue is done. Shuffle again to keep going.

options_api_key_desc.message: Leave empty to use the key bundled with the extension. The key travels with every request to googleapis.com (there is no server), so rotate it here if it ever leaks.

options_site_desc.message: Where the shuffled queue plays. YouTube Music cannot play every regular video; incompatible tracks are skipped automatically.

options_no_key_hint.message: No key configured — add one to enable loading playlists

err_invalid_url.message: That is not a valid URL.

err_unsupported_host.message: Only YouTube or YouTube Music URLs are supported.

err_missing_list_param.message: That URL points to /playlist but has no 'list' parameter.

err_not_a_playlist.message: That URL has no playlist. Use a URL with 'list=…' (a playlist or a watch URL that includes one).

err_auto_mix.message: Auto-generated mixes ('RD…') cannot be loaded with the Data API.

err_liked_music.message: 'Liked music' and private lists ('LL'/'WL') are not accessible.

err_missing_api_key.message: No API key. Set it in the extension options (context menu of the extension → Options).

err_playlist_not_found.message: Playlist not found. Check the URL (it must be public or unlisted).

err_playlist_not_accessible.message: The playlist is not accessible with this API key.

err_quota_exceeded.message: YouTube API quota exceeded. Try again later or use another API key.

err_forbidden.message: The API key was rejected by YouTube (403).

err_no_active_playlists.message: Add at least one playlist and mark it active.

err_no_tracks.message: There are no available tracks after the removes (dedupe).

err_unknown.message: Unexpected error. Check the URL or try again.
